# Ballentine v. Hall, No. 1:26-cv-02331 (E.D. Va.)

> The public docket of this federal case as JSON. Start with the menu, then open only the papers you need.

- [Menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ballentine-dev/docket-edva-1-26-cv-02331/main/menu.md): every paper, one row each
- Paper: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ballentine-dev/docket-edva-1-26-cv-02331/main/papers/ID.json, using an ID from the menu, such as ECF-0084. Each paper lists the papers connected to it under refers_to and referred_to_by
- [Complaints by paragraph](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ballentine-dev/docket-edva-1-26-cv-02331/main/pleadings/menu.md)
- [Everything in one file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ballentine-dev/docket-edva-1-26-cv-02331/main/master-docket.json)
